svg.title: Four Checks Before a Load Moves
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-broker-preflight-decision-tree; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Checks Before a Load Moves; subtitle: Advance on documented evidence; route failed checks to remediation.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values indicate check order, not risk scores. Apply current federal requirements and shipment-specific obligations. Software verification supplements, rather than replaces, document review and trusted-contact confirmation.; caption: The sequence separates broker authority, carrier identity, cash exposure, and cargo risk. Passing one check does not resolve failures in another.; stages: label: Broker authority and required security; value: Pass to identity; otherwise suspend booking; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Confirm active FMCSA property-broker authority, required process-agent designation, and $75,000 BMC-84 bond or BMC-85 trust security under 49 U.S.C. 13904, 13906(b), and 49 CFR 387.307. Verify current provider eligibility and security status; a pending filing does not authorize brokerage operations.; label: Carrier identity and operating eligibility; value: Pass to credit; otherwise investigate mismatches; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Check applicable carrier authority and insurance filings through FMCSA, supplement with Highway or RMIS, and confirm dispatch through a trusted number. Independently verify cargo coverage and bank changes; resolve substituted identities or unauthorized re-brokering before release.; label: Shipper credit and payment float; value: Pass to cargo; otherwise change exposure; numeric value: 3.0; detail: At Base carrier purchases of $2,550,000 annually, a 20-day collection-versus-payment gap requires about $139,726 using annual carrier cost divided by 365. If available cash cannot cover modeled obligations, obtain a deposit, change agreed terms, or reduce volume.; label: Cargo terms and claims readiness; value: Pass to tender; otherwise resolve coverage; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Match commodity, value, exclusions, handling instructions, and contract obligations to verified coverage. 49 U.S.C. 14706 addresses covered carrier cargo liability; broker exposure also depends on conduct and contract. Preserve claim evidence and track applicable deadlines under 49 CFR Part 370.

text.title: Four Checks Before a Load Moves
text.tspan: Four Checks Before a Load Moves

rect.title: label: Broker authority and required security; value: Pass to identity; otherwise suspend booking; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Confirm active FMCSA property-broker authority, required process-agent designation, and $75,000 BMC-84 bond or BMC-85 trust security under 49 U.S.C. 13904, 13906(b), and 49 CFR 387.307. Verify current provider eligibility and security status; a pending filing does not authorize brokerage operations.

text.title: Confirm active FMCSA property-broker authority, required process-agent designation, and $75,000 BMC-84 bond or BMC-85 trust security under 49 U.S.C. 13904, 13906(b), and 49 CFR 387.307. Verify current provider eligibility and security status; a pending filing does not authorize brokerage operations.

rect.title: label: Carrier identity and operating eligibility; value: Pass to credit; otherwise investigate mismatches; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Check applicable carrier authority and insurance filings through FMCSA, supplement with Highway or RMIS, and confirm dispatch through a trusted number. Independently verify cargo coverage and bank changes; resolve substituted identities or unauthorized re-brokering before release.

text.title: Check applicable carrier authority and insurance filings through FMCSA, supplement with Highway or RMIS, and confirm dispatch through a trusted number. Independently verify cargo coverage and bank changes; resolve substituted identities or unauthorized re-brokering before release.

rect.title: label: Shipper credit and payment float; value: Pass to cargo; otherwise change exposure; numeric value: 3.0; detail: At Base carrier purchases of $2,550,000 annually, a 20-day collection-versus-payment gap requires about $139,726 using annual carrier cost divided by 365. If available cash cannot cover modeled obligations, obtain a deposit, change agreed terms, or reduce volume.

Preserve claim evidence and track applicable deadlines under 49 CFR Part 370.

Preserve claim evidence and track applicable deadlines under 49 CFR Part 370.

Assumptions: Numeric values indicate check order, not risk scores. Apply current federal requirements and shipment-specific obligations. Software verification supplements, rather than replaces, document review and trusted-contact confirmation.
